faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Rourkela is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E/M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or an allied branch with a minimum CGPA of 7.0 or 65% and a valid GATE score, or a B.Tech/B.E in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60% and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. Is a GATE score mandatory for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Yes, a valid GATE score is mandatory for the Junior Research Fellow position as per the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Rourkela is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Rourkela located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is located in Rourkela, Odisha, with the pincode 769008.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
